title: Compact onboarding snapshot pack + README sequence illustrations for template apps
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Purpose: Produce a compact, production-ready asset pack (screenshots, annotated README diagrams, and sprite exports) for the template-apps quickstart used in docs, Console release notes, and the starter-app repos. Goal is a small set of canonical images that cover desktop, mobile, CLI/SDK examples, and a short set of explanatory diagrams that can live in the repository README and on the docs site.

Deliverables:
- 6 final screenshots: desktop app (light), desktop app (dark), mobile portrait, mobile landscape, SDK call screenshot, CLI/terminal snippet.
- 3 README diagrams: sequence diagram (user -> starter app -> Redwood API -> model), annotated wireframe spotlighting CTA and config knobs, token-cost micro-infographic.
- Figma source file with named frames for each export, and a ready-to-drop folder in Drive with 2x and 3x PNG/JPEG exports plus SVGs for diagrams.
- A small instructions.md to include in starter repo explaining which images to use and alt text.

Scope and constraints:
- Keep assets under 500KB for web where possible (web-optimized PNG/JPEG). Provide high-res (2048px) in Drive for marketing/press.
- Follow existing Redwood brand tokens for colors and spacing; dark mode assets must match Console dark theme.
- Accessibility: include descriptive alt text strings and a readable overlay for token-cost infographic (contrast >= 4.5:1).

Acceptance criteria:
- All six screenshots exported at 2x and 3x and added to Drive + starter repo PR.
- README diagrams exported as SVG + optimized PNG and included inline in README (and shown in docs site preview).
- Design review approved by PM and Eng; screenshot filenames follow naming convention and README includes alt text and localization notes.

Naming convention for exports (enforced): templateapp_{screen}_{mode}_{scale}.{ext}  e.g. templateapp_dashboard_light_2x.png
